label: Players market: actual points now come straight from MFL's own league scoring (completed weeks only), so free agents no longer read 0.0 and the PPG sort is real. Every number is labelled (YTD pts / L4 pts / Wk N proj / PPG with games), the bid sheet takes a typed $K amount that snaps by the same rule the server enforces, and the player sheet's current-season row matches the market.
